metadata.name: Meritocracy
metadata.description: An equal-opportunity meritocratic ideal favoring selection by relevant competence and achievement rather than inherited status or personal connections.
metadata.scope: A democratic version assigning employment and rewards by relevant demonstrated competence and contribution after fair opportunity, not rule by a hereditary intelligence elite or Michael Young’s satirical dystopia. This is a provisional, scoped interpretation, not a survey of adherents. Modern applications and five-point intensities are inferred. The cited sources establish context; they do not document answers to every quiz statement.
metadata.phrase: Society should provide fair opportunities and assign positions and rewards by relevant demonstrated competence and contribution rather than ancestry, inherited privilege or personal connections.
